sn4.15:1.1: Evam me sutam ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme || || Atha kho Māro pāpimā yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn4.15:2.1: Antalikkhacaro pāso || yo-yam carati mānaso || tena taṃ bādhayissāmi || na me samaṇa mokkhasīti || ||
sn4.15:3.1: Rūpā saddā rasā gandhā || poṭṭhabbā ca manoramā || ettha me vigato chando || nihato tvam asi antakā ti
